messages:
Rae: Pitch: 40m webinar "Engineering Tradeoffs for Low-Cost, Low-Latency Inference" — target audience: infra + platform engineers; goal: generate Dedicated + Optimize trials. Proposed date: Thu Jul 21 10am PT. Need speakers, demo scope, registration fields, rehearsal.

Diego: I can lead the technical framing (10m) and cover kernel selection + batching heuristics.

Nina: I'll run a quantized-model fallback demo + cost delta charts. Need ~15m for demo and 10m for setup/test.

Omar: I'll reach out to a customer (RetailX) for a short 6m case study if legal is ok. Also: capture "deployment interest" (Hosted/Dedicated/Private) on reg form and route Dedicated to AE.

Rae: Run-of-show draft:
10:00-10:05 Intro (Rae)
10:05-10:15 Technical framing (Diego)
10:15-10:30 Live demo (Nina)
10:30-10:36 Customer story (Omar + RetailX)
10:36-10:48 Q&A (panel)
10:48-10:50 Wrap + CTA (Rae)

Diego: Keep demo 15m max. If customer needs more time, shorten Q&A.

Nina: Rehearsal requests: staging pod with warm KV cache, sample load, metrics dashboard URL, recording test. Full dress Jul 20 9am PT or Jul 19 11am PT.

Rae: Let's do Jul 20 09:00 PT for dress. CalendarBot, please create event. Also need speaker bios + headshots by next Tue; promo timeline: 2w email, 1w ads, 2d reminder.

CalendarBot: Event created: "Webinar Dress Rehearsal: Engineering Tradeoffs for Low-Cost, Low-Latency Inference"  Jul 20 16:00 UTC / 09:00 PT. Attendees: Rae, Diego, Nina, Omar.

Omar: I'll add hidden field account_owner and utm_source on the reg form. Also ensure we capture time zone of registrant.

Rae: Action items: Diego = slides + TL;DR slide; Nina = reserve pod + demo checklist; Omar = customer confirm + reg fields; Rae = landing + email templates + schedule. We'll share a pre-webinar snapshot 24h before.

Diego: Starting slides now, will post draft tomorrow.

Nina: Posting staging checklist to #eng-runtime by EOD.

Rae: Great, thanks. We'll reconvene if legal needs more time for RetailX.
